invalid_input: Raise ValueError for blank or non-string input
rationale: One feature and an arbitrary round threshold form a simple baseline, not a tuned complexity classifier.
freeze: Chosen before scoring this rule, after the lead had seen prior aggregate results. Keep 100 fixed even if replay results are poor.
evaluation: Pilot replay is exploratory. Do not train or tune on WorkArena outcomes. The implementation used no actual task goals or outcomes.
